messages:
julia: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight SEV handoff pattern for partners. Calling it 'Partner Orbit' — aim is one predictable activation flow for marketplace vendors, hardware partners, and SIs.

alex: love the name :) can you sketch the phases?

julia: Sure. 3 phases: orbit (signal), rendezvous (shared channel + short war room), handover (formal ticket + follow-up cadence). Keep each step <15 min for tier-1 signals.

sachin: Agreed. For hardware partners we need an explicit oncall phone/bridge step before shared channel in some cases (regulatory customers).

marie: +1. Also want an escalation card template we can DM to the partner liaison to reduce back-and-forth.

julia: Drafted a minimal activation message (send to partners-oncall and create shared channel):
```
/activate-orbit partner=CloudVendorX sev=sev2 customer=AcmeCorp brief=storage-lag impact=throughput
```
Bot auto-creates #orbit-AcmeCorp-CloudVendorX and posts the card.

alex: Can the bot include required fields and a 'must-call' flag for HW partners?

julia: yes. Required fields: partner, sev, customer, impact, contact-phone, escalation-level. If must-call=true, bots ping phone tree and add :phone: header in channel.

partners-oncall-bot: War room created: #orbit-AcmeCorp-CloudVendorX — participants: julia, alex, sachin, marie, vendor-liaison. Escalation card pinned.

marie: Nice. We should add a short SLA for partner response windows and a fallback. Proposal: partner ack within 10m for sev1, 30m for sev2; fallback to Redwood Dedicated oncall if no ack.

alex: fallback sounds right. Also add a 'fallback-model' field in the activation command so routing can switch to a preset model or region.

julia: I'll send a PR with the bot command and the escalation-card template. Quick mock of the pinned card text (short):
"""
SEV: sev2
Customer: AcmeCorp
Partner: CloudVendorX (liaison: @vendor-liaison)
Impact: degraded write throughput
Required: contact-phone, top-3 logs, last-deploy-id
Action: partner ack within 30m or escalate to Redwood oncall
Link: ticket #12345
"""

sachin: One operational ask: ensure we always capture model/version and region in the card for marketplace model rollbacks.

marie: Ops checklist for war room close: RCA owner, follow-up commit, customer message draft, partner lessons. Keep it to 4 bullets.

alex: thumbs — can we run a tabletop next week with 2 partners (cloud + SI) to validate timings?

julia: scheduling now. I'll post invites and a short runbook in docs. Thanks all — will open PR and tagging vendor relations for feedback. :rocket:

marie: thanks! :thumbsup:
